text:
pav: Quick: we have a launch webinar May 12. Need a minimal creative pack for comms and slides. Items: hero benchmark graphic (1200x628), three micro-tiles (360x200), two social squares (1200x1200), one story GIF (500x280), and a single-slide PNG (1024x576). EN + FR outputs. Who can take?

ingrid: I can run design. Confirm brand: neutral-50 hero bg, white cards, tokens v2, sparkline thin stroke.

hugo: I'll draft copy for tiles. Short is better. Also will prepare FR translations.

ingrid: Layout: stacked icon above headline for tiles. Allow extra vertical space for FR. GIF: loop, 3 frames, 0.7s/frame.

design-bot: Filename rule: <product>_<asset>_<lang>_<size>_<v>.png. Eg: inference_hero_en_1200x628_v1.png. Accessibility: stat text contrast >=4.5:1. Add a11y screenshots to Figma comment.

hugo: Copy draft: 1) "Lower unit cost" 2) "Consistent low latency" 3) "Easy rollouts". Will post FR variants by Mon noon.

ingrid: I'll upload v1 frames to Figma page "Launch - May12" by Mon 4pm and add export manifest so ops can batch.

pav: Legal review Wed 10am. Need v1 exported PNGs by Tue EOD. Also include copy deck at /docs/launch/copy_v2.md.

ingrid: Got it. Tagging when done.
